definitions.explanation: The traditional process of making mochi by pounding steamed glutinous rice with a large wooden mallet in a mortar. A festive activity associated with the New Year season.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年末|ねんまつ}→年末：17688_nenmatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{餅|もち}つき⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We did mochi pounding at the end of the year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{町内|ちょうない}{会|かい}→町内会：10193_chounaikai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{餅|もち}つき⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|ひら}かれた→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: A mochi-pounding event was held by the neighborhood association.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{餅|もち}つき⟦{体験|たいけん}→体験：11443_taiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{大|おお}はしゃぎだった。
examples.english: The children were thrilled by their first mochi-pounding experience.

notes:
A traditional New Year preparation activity. Steamed {餅米|もちごめ} (glutinous rice) is placed in an ⟦{臼|うす}→臼：26038_usu⟧ (mortar) and pounded with a ⟦{杵|きね}→杵：26037_kine⟧ (wooden mallet). One person pounds while another turns and wets the rice — this teamwork is called {合|あ}いの{手|て}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {餅|もち}つき⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to pound mochi)
- {餅|もち}つき⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧ (mochi-pounding event)
- {餅|もち}つき⟦{体験|たいけん}→体験：11443_taiken⟧ (mochi-pounding experience)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Traditionally done around December 28 or 30 for New Year preparations. Pounding on the 29th is avoided because 29 can be read as {苦|く} (suffering). Community {餅|もち}つき events remain popular, especially for children.
